task.instructions:
Using matplotlib, plot the mean yield of five reaction conditions with explicit error bars showing the standard error of the mean.
  condition   mean yield (%)   SEM
  Baseline           42.1      2.3
  Cat-A              55.4      3.1
  Cat-B              61.8      1.9
  Cat-C              58.2      2.8
  Cat-D              49.7      4.2
Requirements:
1. Put the conditions on the x axis at positions 0, 1, 2, 3, 4 in the order listed, and use the condition names as the x tick labels.
2. Draw each mean as a marker (no connecting line is required) at its yield value.
3. Draw a symmetric vertical error bar of +/- one SEM on every point, and give the error bars visible end caps (pass capsize with a value greater than zero).
4. The y axis must start at 0 so the yields stay comparable.
5. Give the chart a title and label both axes.

cat <<'EOF' > plot.py
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
data = {
    'condition': ['Baseline', 'Cat-A', 'Cat-B', 'Cat-C', 'Cat-D'],
    'mean yield (%)': [42.1, 55.4, 61.8, 58.2, 49.7],
    'SEM': [2.3, 3.1, 1.9, 2.8, 4.2]
}
df = pd.DataFrame(data)

plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
plt.bar(df['condition'], df['mean yield (%)'], yerr=df['SEM'], capsize=5)
plt.title('Reaction Condition Yield vs SEM')
plt.xlabel('Condition')
plt.ylabel('Mean Yield (%)')
plt.xticks(ticks=[0, 1, 2, 3, 4], labels=df['condition'])
plt.ylim(0, 70)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig("figure.png")
EOF
